category: usenet provider (Dutch, one unlimited plan in three periods)

free_tier.stated: No free tier and no trial stated; the cheapest option is 30 days for EUR 4.95.

per_object_cap.stated: no per-object cap is published; retrieval is by Usenet article over NNTP
per_object_cap.notes: an article size is a protocol convention, not a vendor number

egress.terms: Unlimited speed with 50 connections; no data cap stated

interface_detail: NNTP with SSL enabled by default
tooling: SABnzbd, NZBGet or nzbdav over NNTP/TLS; any newsreader works because the protocol is the same everywhere, and no provider SDK is needed
chaining: Three periods of the same plan (30, 180 and 365 days); the 30-day option is a short fill without a subscription lock.
limits_note: 30 days EUR 4.95; the 180 and 365 day prices were not read on the page captured.
binding_note: Speed and volume are unlimited, so the 50-connection ceiling is the only bound stated.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: the order form was not opened, so the fields it asks for are behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: Backbone is not stated on the page read; the vendor says there is no VPN bundle and support is by ticket.
confidence_note: Price, retention and connections are from the vendor home page read on 2026-11-03.
